content:
jamie: Heads up — we've been seeing a cluster of streaming disconnects where clients get closed with 400/502 while server reports the connection as "gracefully closed by client". Happened after yesterday's proxy upgrade. anyone else?

olivia: saw similar in prod-aws-eu. Sourced to a handful of long-lived ws connections that suddenly downgraded to plain HTTP streaming mid-flight.

mike: @jamie any logs/trace id you can paste?

jamie: trace id: 9c3a7f2b, snippet from proxy logs:
```
[proxy] 2026-03-18T09:32:41Z conn=xyz upgrade: missing header "Sec-WebSocket-Key" -> routing to http/1.1
[upstream] 2026-03-18T09:32:41Z session=9c3a7f2b connection=closed idle_timeout
```

rachel: ohhh proxies dropping Upgrade/Connection headers again. We changed keepalive heuristics in the proxy yesterday.

olivia: the problem is the app runtime treats WS vs SSE differently for ping/pong and billing. When it falls back to HTTP streaming we don't send WS pings so client idle timers fire and the client reconnects — leads to dup billing and opaque console rows.

kevin: current routing policy silently downgrades when headers missing. Maybe we should reject at the proxy with 426 rather than silently switching the protocol.

jamie: agreed. Silent downgrade is worst — downstream logic assumes WS semantics (binary frames, ping/pong), and app ends up with partial frames and then idle close.

mike: quick patch idea: add an enforcement rule in the edge that requires a valid upgrade handshake for routes configured as websocket. If missing, return 400 + hint header `X-Client-Protocol: need-websocket`.

rachel: 👍 Also need to expose protocol detection in console telemetry. Right now the dashboard just shows "streaming" and you can't tell if it was WS or HTTP-stream. Hard for SREs to correlate.

olivia: proposal: add a `connection.protocol` attribute to our connection telemetry (values: "websocket", "sse", "http-stream"). Also emit `disconnect.reason` enum (idle, proxy-reset, client-close, protocol-mismatch).

kevin: will this affect storage size? We're ingesting ~150k conn events/minute.

rachel: we can sample for now. Add full telemetry behind a rollout flag per cluster. Default sample 1% and 100% for canary.

jamie: for the immediate mitigation, can we revert the proxy keepalive change? It seemed to be the root cause.

mike: revert in canary now. infra-bot: deploy rollbacks scheduled.

devops-bot: rollback started for proxy-config on cluster prod-eu-canary — job 4207

olivia: separate thing: console UX. When a reconnect happens due to a protocol downgrade, billing currently counts both connections. Need a dedupe heuristic — if reconnect < 3s and same client-id, don't double-bill.

kevin: caution: some customers legitimately open many quick connections. Dedupe should be opt-in per tenant, or tied to "sticky session" routing tag.

jamie: good point. Prefer to add metric `billing.duplicate_window_ms` and let billing pipeline apply dedupe rules per tenant config.

rachel: timeline: mike revert now, infra verify, then a small edge rule to return 426 on missing Upgrade, and telemetry flag rollout. Can we do that in the next 3h window?

mike: yes to revert now. Edge rule I'll push after revert — needs change to router config and a schema bump. Telemetry flag can be a feature-flag rollout next week.

olivia: also let's add a small note in the incident page: "Proxy keepalive upgrade removal may cause websocket handshakes to be dropped -> server fallback to http-stream causing client idle closes and duplicate billing". Helps CS and SRE triage.

jamie: filing postmortem stub and adding steps. pinging @sarah-product for console billing UX follow-up.

sarah-product: on it. can we add a quick column in connections table with protocol + reason? will unblock support calls.

mike: one more debugging snippet: here's a curl sequence that reproduces the downgrade locally — proxy strips Upgrade => server sends chunked SSE and client hits idle timeout.
```
# WS handshake that should succeed
printf 'GET /v1/stream HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: api.redwood.local\r\nUpgrade: websocket\r\nConnection: Upgrade\r\nSec-WebSocket-Key: abc\r\n\r\n' | nc -q1 localhost 8080

# If proxy removes Upgrade/Connection headers, server sees plain GET and responds with chunked SSE
curl -N http://proxy.local/v1/stream -H 'Accept: text/event-stream'
```

kevin: after revert + edge rule deployed, I'll add the `connection.protocol` to the telemetry schema. We should also map it into the console and make it filterable.

rachel: logging checklist for follow-up: 1) mark all streams that had protocol-mismatch; 2) surface sample of request/response headers for a subset; 3) add bindable tenant flag for dedupe window.

olivia: thanks everyone. Looks like we have an actionable plan. I'll update incident page.

jamie: thanks. keep this thread updated if you see anything after revert.

mike: revert finished on prod-eu-canary, monitoring.

devops-bot: rollback completed: job 4207 ✅

kevin: canary metrics look good — no new protocol-mismatch logs in 10m.

rachel: moving to prod rollback in 15m if stable. then edge rule deploy.

sarah-product: adding console column prototype to a short PR — will link here when ready.

olivia: filing tenant support ticket template for any customers that hit duplicate billing: include connection ids and timestamps.

jamie: thread locked to keep log. thanks all :thumbsup:
